::: {#rem-pmf-pdf-reference-measures}
#### PMFs and PDFs differ in the reference measure

A [PDF](#def-pdf) plays the role of a [PMF](#def-pmf)
with [Lebesgue measure](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/measures-measure-spaces.html#def-lebesgue-measure)
in place of [counting measure](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/measures-measure-spaces.html#def-counting-measure):
@def-pdf integrates it with $dx$.
If the [CDF](#def-cdf) $F$ of a [random variable](#def-random-variable) is [absolutely continuous](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Absolute_continuity),
then $F'$ is a [Radon--Nikodym derivative](#def-density-measure)
of its [distribution](#def-cdf) against Lebesgue measure
[@billingsley1995probability, p. 423].
So a PMF and a PDF are both [densities with respect to a measure](#def-density-measure),
for different reference measures.
Because the two share that role,
these notes write $f_X$ for both,
and the [joint-distribution form of Fubini--Tonelli](expectation.qmd#cor-fubini-joint)
covers PMFs, PDFs, and density-mass [functions](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/functions.html#def-function) in one statement.

:::
